items.title: The Lakers lead the Warriors 63-50 at the half. That was the best half of basketball the Lakers have had since their first preseason game. Austin Reaves has 23 points. Walker Kessler is finally playing. He has 11 points, 9 rebounds, and a plus-minus of +15, the best on the team.

items.title: Lakers lead Warriors 63-50 at halftime
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Lakers lead Warriors 63-50 at halftime

No midrange for the Lakers, only 12 free throw attempts, minimal offensive rebounds, and Austin Reaves has 5 of the 12 turnovers

Shows you how much Lakers are just pummeling Warriors defense in paint (15/21 FGs in paint) and from 3 (8/19 3s)

Reaves: 23/3/6

items.title: Bonus Hollander POTD Doc Rivers. 2nd rounder from Marquette started at PG for ATL for most of 80s. He put up 10 apg in 86-87 + was an All-Star in 87-88. Broke down early (bench guy by age 30) but was hustler for LAC, NY + SA thru 96. Storied post-playing career in TV & as coach.
